1. **Validation** (`RegistrationValidator`, domain, SB-01): trim all strings (BR-02); required fields per type (BR-01: external = firstName, lastName, email, organization; student = firstName, lastName, email, studyInstitution, studyProgramme, studentId); fields of the other type must be absent or empty (`NOT_ALLOWED`); max length 200 (email 254); reject any Unicode control character (`Character.getType == CONTROL`, D-14, SR-05); email: one `@`, non-empty local part ≤ 64 of `[A-Za-z0-9!#$%&'*+/=?^_`{\|}~.-]` without leading/trailing/double dot, domain of dot-separated labels `[A-Za-z0-9-]` (no leading/trailing hyphen) with at least one dot and a TLD of ≥ 2 letters (BR-03); option ids must exist, be active and include the type in their audience, no duplicates (BR-04, SR-04, D-08, D-11); every mandatory consent id given, unknown consent ids rejected (BR-05); `captchaToken` non-empty. Field codes: `REQUIRED`, `TOO_LONG`, `INVALID_CHARACTERS`, `INVALID_EMAIL`, `NOT_ALLOWED`, `UNKNOWN_OPTION`, `OPTION_NOT_AVAILABLE`, `DUPLICATE_OPTION`, `CONSENT_REQUIRED`, `UNKNOWN_CONSENT`. All errors are collected and returned together (400).
2. **reCAPTCHA** (SR-01): `CaptchaVerifier.verify(token, clientIp)`. Production: `GoogleRecaptchaVerifier` POSTs `secret`, `response`, `remoteip` (form encoded) to `app.recaptcha.verify-url` with 5 s timeouts and accepts only `{"success": true}` (contract `02_contracts/recaptcha-siteverify.openapi.yaml`); any other answer, HTTP error or timeout rejects. Test mode (`TestModeCaptchaVerifier`, only when `app.recaptcha.test-mode=true`): accepts exactly the token `test-pass`. Rejected → 400 `CAPTCHA_FAILED`.
3. **Duplicate email** (D-12): `email_normalized = lower(trim(email))` (root locale) checked, and enforced by a unique index; a concurrent duplicate that hits the index maps to 409 as well.
4. **Storage** (AR-05, BR-07): in one `@Transactional` method, insert the registration rows and flush, then `JsonCopyStore.write(reference, bytes)` (write to a temp file in the same directory, `fsync`, atomic move to `registration-<reference>.json`). If writing fails, the exception rolls the transaction back (AC-005-02). If the commit fails after the file is written, a transaction synchronisation deletes the file (AC-005-03). Only then is `201` built. The JSON bytes are produced once and reused for the file and the organizer attachment (AC-007-01).
5. **Notifications** (D-10): after commit, `Notifier.sendParticipantConfirmation` and `Notifier.sendOrganizerNotification`, each in its own try/catch; failures are logged with the reference only (no personal data, ES-07). SMTP connect/read timeouts 5 s.

Response `201`: `{reference, submittedAt, type, firstName, lastName, options[{id, name, category}]}` (used by the confirmation, BR-06).

Reference: random UUID (v4) string. Submission time: UTC instant, millisecond precision.

## 5. Persistence (AR-06, ES-08, contract `02_contracts/database-schema.sql`)

Flyway migrations in `backend/src/main/resources/db/migration` (`V1__create_registration_tables.sql`); `spring.jpa.hibernate.ddl-auto=validate`. Tables: `registration` (internal `id`, `reference` unique, `type`, the participant fields, `email_normalized` unique, `submitted_at`), `registration_option` (option id, name snapshot, category, position), `registration_consent` (consent id, text snapshot, `given_at`). Text columns are `varchar` in a UTF-8 database (NFR-01). Option names are snapshotted so the export stays correct after the configuration changes.

JSON copy (contract `02_contracts/registration-copy.schema.json`): UTF-8, one file per registration in `app.json-copy.directory`, never overwritten (`CREATE_NEW` semantics on the final name). Both database and directory are on named volumes (`pgdata`, `jsoncopies`) that survive `docker compose down`/`up` (NFR-02).

## 6. Emails (SR-05, SR-07, contract `02_contracts/emails.yaml`)

`MailNotifier` with `JavaMailSender` and `MimeMessageHelper`, UTF-8, `text/plain` only (markup stays literal, AC-006-02). Header values are fixed or from configuration: From = `app.mail.sender`, Subject = `<conference name> – registration confirmed (<reference>)` / `<conference name> – new registration <reference>`; the only participant value in any header is the participant's address as recipient of the confirmation, already validated without control characters. Organizer email: To = all `app.organizer.emails`, body lists the registration data only (labels + values, options by category, consents with time), attachment `registration-<reference>.json` (`application/json`, the JSON copy bytes).

## 7. Export (US-008, BR-08, SR-06, SR-07)

`ExportService` reads all registrations ordered by submission time; `PoiWorkbookWriter` writes one sheet `Registrations` with header row and columns: Reference, Submitted at (UTC ISO-8601), Type, First name, Last name, Email, Organization / institution, Study institution, Study programme, Student ID, Workshops, Events, Meals, Other activities, Consents. Every cell is a string cell (no formula evaluation of user input). Internal ids are never exported. Response: `Content-Type: application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet`, `Content-Disposition: attachment; filename="registrations.xlsx"`, `Cache-Control: no-store`.

## 8. Security (ASVS 5.0 Level 1, SB-01..SB-14, SR-01..SR-07)

- Spring Security filter chain: `/api/export/**` requires role `ORGANIZER` via HTTP Basic, everything else under `/api/**` and `/actuator/health/**` is `permitAll`; all other paths denied. Stateless (no session), CSRF disabled because no cookie/session authentication exists (Basic credentials are not sent automatically cross-site from a form); 401 responses carry the JSON error body and `WWW-Authenticate: Basic realm="organizer"`.
- Organizer password: hashed with BCrypt (strength 12) at startup into an in-memory user store; the plain value is not retained in the user store (SB-03).
- `HttpsOnlyFilter` before authentication: when `app.organizer.https-only=true`, a request to `/api/export/**` that is not secure (`request.isSecure()`, which honours `X-Forwarded-Proto` from trusted proxies through `server.forward-headers-strategy=native`) and whose remote address is not loopback is refused with 403 `HTTPS_REQUIRED` (SR-06, AC-008-03).
- `RateLimitFilter`: fixed window per client IP (`request.getRemoteAddr()` after forwarded-header processing) and bucket (`POST /api/registrations`, `/api/export/**`), in memory, limits from configuration → 429 with `Retry-After` (SR-03, SB-06). Single backend instance assumed (release notes).
- `RequestSizeFilter`: `Content-Length` above `app.request.max-body-bytes` → 413; bodies without length are read through a counting stream that fails with 413 when exceeded (SR-03).
- Headers (SB-10): `Content-Security-Policy: default-src 'none'; frame-ancestors 'none'` on API responses, `X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff`, `X-Frame-Options: DENY`, `Referrer-Policy: no-referrer`, `Cache-Control: no-store`. Frontend nginx: CSP `default-src 'self'; script-src 'self' https://www.google.com/recaptcha/ https://www.gstatic.com/recaptcha/; frame-src https://www.google.com/recaptcha/ https://recaptcha.google.com/recaptcha/; connect-src 'self'; img-src 'self' data:; style-src 'self'; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'self'; form-action 'self'; frame-ancestors 'none'`, plus `X-Content-Type-Options`, `X-Frame-Options: DENY`, `Referrer-Policy: no-referrer`.
- CORS: only when `app.cors.allowed-origin` is set (local development via Vite), `GET`/`POST`, no credentials.
- JPA with bound parameters only (SB-05); React escapes output (SB-05).
- Logging: no request bodies, no personal data, no secrets; errors logged with the reference or an error id (ES-07, SB-07). `server.error.include-*` = never.
- Containers run as non-root (SB-11); TLS outside localhost is provided by the external nginx (SB-04).
- Privacy (SB-12..SB-14): only the fields of BR-01 are collected; purposes and retention in `security-requirements.md` with D-13 (≤ 12 months after the conference, manual deletion); consents unchecked by default and stored with time (SB-14, D-09).
- Scanning (SB-08, SB-09): Dependency-Check and `npm audit` (dependencies), SpotBugs, PMD and Semgrep (static analysis), Gitleaks (secrets) in phase 6.

## 9. Frontend (contract `02_contracts/registration-ui.yaml`)

`App` loads `GET /api/form-config`, shows a type choice (radio: external participant / student), then `RegistrationForm` with the type's fields, options grouped by category (checkboxes, filtered by audience), consents (unchecked checkboxes), the `Captcha` component and a submit button. Client validation mirrors the backend rules for required, length, control characters, email format and mandatory consents (NFR-03); errors render in an element `id="<field>-error"` referenced by `aria-describedby`. On `201` the form is replaced by `Confirmation` (reference, name, options) (BR-06). On 400/409 the backend `fieldErrors` are shown next to their fields; on other errors a general message without internal details is shown and values stay (AC-004-02). The `Captcha` component: in test mode renders a checkbox "I am not a robot (test mode)" yielding the token `test-pass`; otherwise loads `https://www.google.com/recaptcha/api.js` and renders the v2 widget with the site key from `/api/form-config` (AR-07); the widget is reset after every rejected submission. All calls use relative `/api/...` URLs (AR-01).

## 10. Health and operations (ES-09, NFR-04)

Actuator exposes only `health` with liveness and readiness groups (`management.endpoint.health.probes.enabled=true`, details never shown). Readiness includes the database. Compose health checks: backend `wget -qO- http://127.0.0.1:8080/actuator/health/readiness`, frontend `wget -qO- http://127.0.0.1:8080/`, postgres `pg_isready`; `depends_on: condition: service_healthy`.

## 11. Commands (ES-05)

| Component | Build | Test | Check | Run |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| backend | `./mvnw -B -DskipTests package` | `./mvnw -B verify` | `./mvnw -B spotless:check pmd:check pmd:cpd-check spotbugs:check` | `./mvnw spring-boot:run` (with local settings) or `docker compose up backend` |
| frontend | `npm run build` | `npm test` (unit/component/acceptance), `npm run test:e2e` (against the local stack) | `npm run check` | `npm run dev` or `docker compose up frontend` |

## 12. Tests (planned, detailed in `03_test-strategy.md`)

- Backend acceptance (`src/test/java/.../acceptance/`): `@SpringBootTest(webEnvironment = RANDOM_PORT)` over HTTP, Testcontainers PostgreSQL, Mailpit container (Testcontainers `GenericContainer`, image from `tech-stack.md`) read through its HTTP API, a JDK `HttpServer` as the mocked reCAPTCHA endpoint (production code path, DoD-P05), temporary JSON copy directory.
- Frontend acceptance (`tests/acceptance/`): Vitest + Testing Library through the rendered UI with a mocked `fetch`.
- End-to-end (`e2e/`): Playwright against the compose stack (frontend 8081, Mailpit 8025), test-mode reCAPTCHA.
- Architecture: ArchUnit `ArchitectureTest` (AR-02, AR-03, AR-06 no JDBC DDL outside migrations is not checkable by ArchUnit; checked by review).
- Unit: phase 5.

    story: US-007
    to: ["<each address in app.organizer.emails>"]

                    type: string

# Local stack (environments.md "local"): plain HTTP on 127.0.0.1 only.
# Build the backend jar first, then from 02_output/:
#   docker compose --env-file ../.env up -d --build
name: konferenca-registration

services:
  postgres:
    image: postgres:16.15-alpine
    environment:
      POSTGRES_DB: registration
      POSTGRES_USER: registration
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: ${POSTGRES_PASSWORD:?set POSTGRES_PASSWORD in .env}
    volumes:
      - pgdata:/var/lib/postgresql/data
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "pg_isready -U registration -d registration"]
      interval: 5s
      timeout: 3s
      retries: 20

  mailpit:
    image: axllent/mailpit:v1.31.1
    ports:
      - "127.0.0.1:8025:8025"

  backend:
    build: ./backend
    depends_on:
      postgres:
        condition: service_healthy
      mailpit:
        condition: service_started
    environment:
      APP_ENVIRONMENT: local
      SPRING_DATASOURCE_URL: jdbc:postgresql://postgres:5432/registration
      SPRING_DATASOURCE_USERNAME: registration
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: ${POSTGRES_PASSWORD:?set POSTGRES_PASSWORD in .env}
      SPRING_MAIL_HOST: mailpit
      SPRING_MAIL_PORT: "1025"
      APP_MAIL_SENDER: registration@konferenca.local
      APP_CONFERENCENAME: Konferenca 2026
      ORGANIZER_USERNAME: ${ORGANIZER_USERNAME:?set ORGANIZER_USERNAME in .env}
      ORGANIZER_PASSWORD: ${ORGANIZER_PASSWORD:?set ORGANIZER_PASSWORD in .env}
      ORGANIZER_EMAILS: ${ORGANIZER_EMAILS:?set ORGANIZER_EMAILS in .env}
      APP_ORGANIZER_HTTPSONLY: "false"
      APP_RECAPTCHA_TESTMODE: "true"
      APP_OPTIONS_LOCATION: file:/config/conference-options.json
      APP_JSONCOPY_DIRECTORY: /data/json-copies
    volumes:
      - jsoncopies:/data/json-copies
      - ./config/conference-options.json:/config/conference-options.json:ro
    ports:
      - "127.0.0.1:8080:8080"
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "wget -qO- http://127.0.0.1:8080/actuator/health/readiness >/dev/null || exit 1"]
      interval: 5s
      timeout: 3s
      retries: 30
      start_period: 20s

  frontend:
    build: ./frontend
    depends_on:
      backend:
        condition: service_healthy
    ports:
      - "127.0.0.1:8081:8080"
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "wget -qO- http://127.0.0.1:8080/ >/dev/null || exit 1"]
      interval: 5s
      timeout: 3s
      retries: 10

volumes:
  pgdata:
  jsoncopies:

The backend, frontend and container stack are built, but phase 4 can't close: one frozen acceptance test can never pass, and only you can approve changing it (decision D-15).

**Where things stand**
- 97 of the 98 frozen tests pass:
  - backend acceptance: 80 of 81
  - frontend acceptance: 12 of 12
  - end-to-end: 5 of 5, run against the local Docker Compose stack
- Format, lint, type check, PMD and SpotBugs all report no problems on both components.
- Phase 0 to 3 are done and every story is committed. Two decisions I made myself are recorded for your later review: D-08 to D-14 answer the six open questions in `scope.md`, and D-16 switches off two SpotBugs warning types that only flagged false positives.

**D-15: the one failing test is wrong, not the code**
The test is `ac_008_03_plainHttpFromRemoteClientIsRefused` in `RegistrationExportAcceptanceTest.java`. It checks that a refused export doesn't return an Excel file with:

```java
assertThat(response.body()).doesNotContain(new byte[] {'P', 'K', 3, 4});
```

For byte arrays this fails if the body contains *any* of those bytes, not the four-byte ZIP signature in sequence. The same test also requires the body to contain `HTTPS_REQUIRED`, which contains a 'P', so no implementation can pass it. The backend already does what AC-008-03 asks: it returns 403 `HTTPS_REQUIRED` and no workbook.

1. **(my recommendation)** Approve replacing that one line with a check on the first four bytes:
   `assertThat(java.util.Arrays.copyOf(response.body(), 4)).isNotEqualTo(new byte[] {'P', 'K', 3, 4});`
   I'll commit the test change and the updated manifest hash separately, rerun the full suite and move on to phase 5 (unit tests).
2. Leave the test as it is. AC-008-03 stays red and phase 4 can't pass.

One more thing to know: two early commits (US-003 with 21 files, US-005 with 675 lines) went over the commit size guide without saying why in the message. History can't be rewritten, so I've recorded both as deviations in the run log.

content.text: Now the runtime demonstration against the local stack (DoD-06, DoD-P01..P04, NFR-02, NFR-04). Writing it as a script so the log is reproducible and contains no secret values.

input.content:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Phase 6 runtime demonstration. Run from 02_output/. Prints no secret values.
set -u
ENV=../.env
U="$(sed -n 's/^ORGANIZER_USERNAME=//p' $ENV | tr -d '\r')"
P="$(sed -n 's/^ORGANIZER_PASSWORD=//p' $ENV | tr -d '\r')"
DC="docker compose --env-file $ENV"
FE=http://127.0.0.1:8081
MP=http://127.0.0.1:8025
STAMP=$(date +%s)
EXT_EMAIL="demo-ext-$STAMP@example.si"
STU_EMAIL="demo-stu-$STAMP@example.si"
SCRATCH="$1"

step() { echo; echo "=== $*"; }

step "1. Start the stack (build, wait for health checks)"
$DC up -d --build --wait 2>&1 | grep -E "Healthy|Started|Running|Built" | sort -u
$DC ps --format "table {{.Service}}\t{{.Image}}\t{{.Status}}"

step "2. Health and readiness (NFR-04, ES-09)"
echo "readiness: $(curl -s http://127.0.0.1:8080/actuator/health/readiness)"
echo "liveness:  $(curl -s http://127.0.0.1:8080/actuator/health/liveness)"
echo "actuator env exposed? status $(curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' http://127.0.0.1:8080/actuator/env)"

step "3. Processes run as non-root (SB-11)"
echo "backend:  $($DC exec -T backend id)"
echo "frontend: $($DC exec -T frontend id)"

step "4. Security headers (SB-10)"
curl -sI $FE/ | grep -iE "^(content-security-policy|x-frame-options|x-content-type-options|referrer-policy)"
curl -sI $FE/api/form-config | grep -iE "^(content-security-policy|x-frame-options|x-content-type-options|cache-control)"

step "5. Form configuration through the frontend origin (AR-01)"
curl -s $FE/api/form-config | head -c 400; echo

step "6. External registration (DoD-P01, NFR-01)"
EXT=$(curl -s -w '\nstatus %{http_code}' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -X POST $FE/api/registrations \
  --data-binary "{\"type\":\"EXTERNAL\",\"firstName\":\"Čedomir Šime\",\"lastName\":\"Žagar\",\"email\":\"$EXT_EMAIL\",\"organization\":\"Univerza v Ljubljani – FRI\",\"optionIds\":[\"ws-ai\",\"ev-gala\",\"meal-lunch\"],\"consentIds\":[\"data-processing\"],\"captchaToken\":\"test-pass\"}")
echo "$EXT"
EXT_REF=$(echo "$EXT" | grep -oE '"reference":"[^"]+"' | cut -d'"' -f4)

step "7. Student registration (DoD-P01)"
STU=$(curl -s -w '\nstatus %{http_code}' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -X POST $FE/api/registrations \
  --data-binary "{\"type\":\"STUDENT\",\"firstName\":\"Luka\",\"lastName\":\"Kranjc\",\"email\":\"$STU_EMAIL\",\"studyInstitution\":\"Univerza v Mariboru\",\"studyProgramme\":\"Računalništvo in informatika\",\"studentId\":\"E1234567\",\"optionIds\":[\"ev-student-night\"],\"consentIds\":[\"data-processing\",\"photos\"],\"captchaToken\":\"test-pass\"}")
echo "$STU"
STU_REF=$(echo "$STU" | grep -oE '"reference":"[^"]+"' | cut -d'"' -f4)

step "8. Rejections: bad captcha token, duplicate email"
curl -s -w '  status %{http_code}\n' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -X POST $FE/api/registrations \
  --data-binary "{\"type\":\"EXTERNAL\",\"firstName\":\"A\",\"lastName\":\"B\",\"email\":\"demo-bot-$STAMP@example.si\",\"organization\":\"O\",\"optionIds\":[],\"consentIds\":[\"data-processing\"],\"captchaToken\":\"robot\"}"
curl -s -w '  status %{http_code}\n' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -X POST $FE/api/registrations \
  --data-binary "{\"type\":\"EXTERNAL\",\"firstName\":\"A\",\"lastName\":\"B\",\"email\":\"$(echo $EXT_EMAIL | tr a-z A-Z)\",\"organization\":\"O\",\"optionIds\":[],\"consentIds\":[\"data-processing\"],\"captchaToken\":\"test-pass\"}"

check_storage() {
  echo "-- PostgreSQL rows"
  $DC exec -T postgres psql -U registration -d registration -At -c \
    "select reference, type, first_name, last_name, coalesce(organization, study_institution) from registration where reference in ('$EXT_REF','$STU_REF') order by type;"
  echo "-- options and consents"
  $DC exec -T postgres psql -U registration -d registration -At -c \
    "select r.type, o.option_id, o.option_name from registration r join registration_option o on o.registration_id = r.id where r.reference in ('$EXT_REF','$STU_REF') order by r.type, o.position;"
  $DC exec -T postgres psql -U registration -d registration -At -c \
    "select r.type, c.consent_id, c.given_at from registration r join registration_consent c on c.registration_id = r.id where r.reference in ('$EXT_REF','$STU_REF') order by r.type, c.consent_id;"
  echo "-- JSON copies"
  $DC exec -T backend ls -l /data/json-copies/registration-$EXT_REF.json /data/json-copies/registration-$STU_REF.json
  $DC exec -T backend cat /data/json-copies/registration-$EXT_REF.json
}

step "9. Storage: database row and JSON copy (DoD-P02, BR-07)"
check_storage

step "10. Emails in Mailpit (DoD-P03)"
for REF in $EXT_REF $STU_REF; do
  curl -s "$MP/api/v1/search?query=$REF" | node -e '
    let s="";process.stdin.on("data",d=>s+=d).on("end",()=>{const r=JSON.parse(s);
    for(const m of r.messages)console.log("to="+m.To.map(t=>t.Address).join(",")+" | subject="+m.Subject+" | attachments="+m.Attachments);})'
done
ORG_ID=$(curl -s "$MP/api/v1/search?query=subject:%22new%20registration%20$EXT_REF%22" | node -e 'let s="";process.stdin.on("data",d=>s+=d).on("end",()=>console.log(JSON.parse(s).messages[0].ID))')
curl -s "$MP/api/v1/message/$ORG_ID" | node -e '
  let s="";process.stdin.on("data",d=>s+=d).on("end",()=>{const m=JSON.parse(s);
  console.log("attachment: "+m.Attachments.map(a=>a.FileName+" ("+a.ContentType+")").join(", "));
  console.log("--- organizer email text ---\n"+m.Text);})'
PART=$(curl -s "$MP/api/v1/message/$ORG_ID" | node -e 'let s="";process.stdin.on("data",d=>s+=d).on("end",()=>console.log(JSON.parse(s).Attachments[0].PartID))')
curl -s "$MP/api/v1/message/$ORG_ID/part/$PART" > "$SCRATCH/attached.json"
$DC exec -T backend cat /data/json-copies/registration-$EXT_REF.json > "$SCRATCH/copy.json"
cmp -s "$SCRATCH/attached.json" "$SCRATCH/copy.json" && echo "attachment is byte-identical to the JSON copy" || echo "ATTACHMENT DIFFERS"

check_export() {
  echo "without credentials: status $(curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' $FE/api/export/registrations.xlsx)"
  echo "wrong password:      status $(curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' -u "$U:wrong-password-123456" $FE/api/export/registrations.xlsx)"
  curl -s -u "$U:$P" -D "$SCRATCH/export.headers" -o "$SCRATCH/export.xlsx" $FE/api/export/registrations.xlsx
  echo "organizer:           $(head -1 "$SCRATCH/export.headers" | tr -d '\r')"
  grep -iE "^(content-type|content-disposition|cache-control)" "$SCRATCH/export.headers" | tr -d '\r'
  node "$SCRATCH/xlsx-rows.cjs" "$SCRATCH/export.xlsx" "$EXT_REF" "$STU_REF"
}

step "11. Excel export (DoD-P04, US-008)"
check_export

step "12. Recreate every container: docker compose down, then up (NFR-02)"
$DC down 2>&1 | grep -cE "Removed" | sed 's/^/containers removed: /'
$DC up -d --wait 2>&1 | grep -E "Healthy" | sort -u

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Phase 6 runtime demonstration. Run from 02_output/. Prints no secret values.
set -u
ENV=../.env
U="$(sed -n 's/^ORGANIZER_USERNAME=//p' $ENV | tr -d '\r')"
P="$(sed -n 's/^ORGANIZER_PASSWORD=//p' $ENV | tr -d '\r')"
DC="docker compose --env-file $ENV"
FE=http://127.0.0.1:8081
MP=http://127.0.0.1:8025
STAMP=$(date +%s)
EXT_EMAIL="demo-ext-$STAMP@example.si"
STU_EMAIL="demo-stu-$STAMP@example.si"
SCRATCH="$1"

step() { echo; echo "=== $*"; }

step "1. Start the stack (build, wait for health checks)"
$DC up -d --build --wait 2>&1 | grep -E "Healthy|Started|Running|Built" | sort -u
$DC ps --format "table {{.Service}}\t{{.Image}}\t{{.Status}}"

step "2. Health and readiness (NFR-04, ES-09)"
echo "readiness: $(curl -s http://127.0.0.1:8080/actuator/health/readiness)"
echo "liveness:  $(curl -s http://127.0.0.1:8080/actuator/health/liveness)"
echo "actuator env exposed? status $(curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' http://127.0.0.1:8080/actuator/env)"

step "3. Processes run as non-root (SB-11)"
echo "backend:  $($DC exec -T backend id)"
echo "frontend: $($DC exec -T frontend id)"

step "4. Security headers (SB-10)"
curl -sI $FE/ | grep -iE "^(content-security-policy|x-frame-options|x-content-type-options|referrer-policy)"
curl -sI $FE/api/form-config | grep -iE "^(content-security-policy|x-frame-options|x-content-type-options|cache-control)"

step "5. Form configuration through the frontend origin (AR-01)"
curl -s $FE/api/form-config | head -c 400; echo

step "6. External registration (DoD-P01, NFR-01)"
EXT=$(curl -s -w '\nstatus %{http_code}' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -X POST $FE/api/registrations \
  --data-binary "{\"type\":\"EXTERNAL\",\"firstName\":\"Čedomir Šime\",\"lastName\":\"Žagar\",\"email\":\"$EXT_EMAIL\",\"organization\":\"Univerza v Ljubljani – FRI\",\"optionIds\":[\"ws-ai\",\"ev-gala\",\"meal-lunch\"],\"consentIds\":[\"data-processing\"],\"captchaToken\":\"test-pass\"}")
echo "$EXT"
EXT_REF=$(echo "$EXT" | grep -oE '"reference":"[^"]+"' | cut -d'"' -f4)

step "7. Student registration (DoD-P01)"
STU=$(curl -s -w '\nstatus %{http_code}' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -X POST $FE/api/registrations \
  --data-binary "{\"type\":\"STUDENT\",\"firstName\":\"Luka\",\"lastName\":\"Kranjc\",\"email\":\"$STU_EMAIL\",\"studyInstitution\":\"Univerza v Mariboru\",\"studyProgramme\":\"Računalništvo in informatika\",\"studentId\":\"E1234567\",\"optionIds\":[\"ev-student-night\"],\"consentIds\":[\"data-processing\",\"photos\"],\"captchaToken\":\"test-pass\"}")
echo "$STU"
STU_REF=$(echo "$STU" | grep -oE '"reference":"[^"]+"' | cut -d'"' -f4)

step "8. Rejections: bad captcha token, duplicate email"
curl -s -w '  status %{http_code}\n' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -X POST $FE/api/registrations \
  --data-binary "{\"type\":\"EXTERNAL\",\"firstName\":\"A\",\"lastName\":\"B\",\"email\":\"demo-bot-$STAMP@example.si\",\"organization\":\"O\",\"optionIds\":[],\"consentIds\":[\"data-processing\"],\"captchaToken\":\"robot\"}"
curl -s -w '  status %{http_code}\n' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -X POST $FE/api/registrations \
  --data-binary "{\"type\":\"EXTERNAL\",\"firstName\":\"A\",\"lastName\":\"B\",\"email\":\"$(echo $EXT_EMAIL | tr a-z A-Z)\",\"organization\":\"O\",\"optionIds\":[],\"consentIds\":[\"data-processing\"],\"captchaToken\":\"test-pass\"}"

check_storage() {
  echo "-- PostgreSQL rows"
  $DC exec -T postgres psql -U registration -d registration -At -c \
    "select reference, type, first_name, last_name, coalesce(organization, study_institution) from registration where reference in ('$EXT_REF','$STU_REF') order by type;"
  echo "-- options and consents"
  $DC exec -T postgres psql -U registration -d registration -At -c \
    "select r.type, o.option_id, o.option_name from registration r join registration_option o on o.registration_id = r.id where r.reference in ('$EXT_REF','$STU_REF') order by r.type, o.position;"
  $DC exec -T postgres psql -U registration -d registration -At -c \
    "select r.type, c.consent_id, c.given_at from registration r join registration_consent c on c.registration_id = r.id where r.reference in ('$EXT_REF','$STU_REF') order by r.type, c.consent_id;"
  echo "-- JSON copies"
  $DC exec -T backend ls -l /data/json-copies/registration-$EXT_REF.json /data/json-copies/registration-$STU_REF.json
  $DC exec -T backend cat /data/json-copies/registration-$EXT_REF.json
}

step "9. Storage: database row and JSON copy (DoD-P02, BR-07)"
check_storage

step "10. Emails in Mailpit (DoD-P03)"
for REF in $EXT_REF $STU_REF; do
  curl -s "$MP/api/v1/search?query=$REF" | node -e '
    let s="";process.stdin.on("data",d=>s+=d).on("end",()=>{const r=JSON.parse(s);
    for(const m of r.messages)console.log("to="+m.To.map(t=>t.Address).join(",")+" | subject="+m.Subject+" | attachments="+m.Attachments);})'
done
ORG_ID=$(curl -s "$MP/api/v1/search?query=subject:%22new%20registration%20$EXT_REF%22" | node -e 'let s="";process.stdin.on("data",d=>s+=d).on("end",()=>console.log(JSON.parse(s).messages[0].ID))')
curl -s "$MP/api/v1/message/$ORG_ID" | node -e '
  let s="";process.stdin.on("data",d=>s+=d).on("end",()=>{const m=JSON.parse(s);
  console.log("attachment: "+m.Attachments.map(a=>a.FileName+" ("+a.ContentType+")").join(", "));
  console.log("--- organizer email text ---\n"+m.Text);})'
PART=$(curl -s "$MP/api/v1/message/$ORG_ID" | node -e 'let s="";process.stdin.on("data",d=>s+=d).on("end",()=>console.log(JSON.parse(s).Attachments[0].PartID))')
curl -s "$MP/api/v1/message/$ORG_ID/part/$PART" > "$SCRATCH/attached.json"
$DC exec -T backend cat /data/json-copies/registration-$EXT_REF.json > "$SCRATCH/copy.json"
cmp -s "$SCRATCH/attached.json" "$SCRATCH/copy.json" && echo "attachment is byte-identical to the JSON copy" || echo "ATTACHMENT DIFFERS"

check_export() {
  echo "without credentials: status $(curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' $FE/api/export/registrations.xlsx)"
  echo "wrong password:      status $(curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' -u "$U:wrong-password-123456" $FE/api/export/registrations.xlsx)"
  curl -s -u "$U:$P" -D "$SCRATCH/export.headers" -o "$SCRATCH/export.xlsx" $FE/api/export/registrations.xlsx
  echo "organizer:           $(head -1 "$SCRATCH/export.headers" | tr -d '\r')"
  grep -iE "^(content-type|content-disposition|cache-control)" "$SCRATCH/export.headers" | tr -d '\r'
  node "$SCRATCH/xlsx-rows.cjs" "$SCRATCH/export.xlsx" "$EXT_REF" "$STU_REF"
}

step "11. Excel export (DoD-P04, US-008)"
check_export

step "12. Recreate every container: docker compose down, then up (NFR-02)"
$DC down 2>&1 | grep -cE "Removed" | sed 's/^/containers removed: /'
$DC up -d --wait 2>&1 | grep -E "Healthy" | sort -u
check_storage
check_export
echo; echo "=== done"

Startup guards (`StartupGuard`, fail start with a message naming the setting, never its value):

- Spring Security filter chain: `/api/export/**` requires role `ORGANIZER` via HTTP Basic, everything else under `/api/**` and `/actuator/health/**` is `permitAll`; all other paths denied. Stateless (no session), CSRF disabled because no cookie/session authentication exists (Basic credentials are not sent automatically cross-site from a form); 401 responses carry the JSON error body and `WWW-Authenticate: Basic realm="organizer"`.
- Organizer password: hashed with BCrypt (strength 12) at startup into an in-memory user store; the plain value is not retained in the user store (SB-03).

- `HttpsOnlyFilter` before authentication: when `app.organizer.https-only=true`, a request to `/api/export/**` that is not secure (`request.isSecure()`, which honours `X-Forwarded-Proto` from trusted proxies through `server.forward-headers-strategy=native`) and whose remote address is not loopback is refused with 403 `HTTPS_REQUIRED` (SR-06, AC-008-03).

-- `RateLimitFilter`: fixed window per client IP (`request.getRemoteAddr()` after forwarded-header processing) and bucket (`POST /api/registrations`, `/api/export/**`), in memory, limits from configuration → 429 with `Retry-After` (SR-03, SB-06). Single backend instance assumed (release notes).

+- `RateLimitFilter`: fixed window per client IP (`request.getRemoteAddr()` after forwarded-header processing) and bucket (`POST /api/registrations`, `/api/export/**`, every other `/api/**` request), in memory, limits from configuration → 429 with `Retry-After` (SR-03, SB-06). Single backend instance assumed (release notes).
- `RequestSizeFilter`: `Content-Length` above `app.request.max-body-bytes` → 413; bodies without length are read through a counting stream that fails with 413 when exceeded (SR-03).

- Headers (SB-10): `Content-Security-Policy: default-src 'none'; frame-ancestors 'none'` on API responses, `X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff`, `X-Frame-Options: DENY`, `Referrer-Policy: no-referrer`, `Cache-Control: no-store`. Phase 6 (verification) is nearly done, but I need one decision from you (D-18) before its gate can pass.

**Where things stand**
- **Tests:** everything passes on the final code: backend 197, frontend 59, end-to-end 5.
- **Integrity:** the frozen-test manifest (26 files) and input manifest (35 files) still match. No `.env` value appears in any file or commit message.
- **Scans:** Dependency-Check, Semgrep, SpotBugs and PMD report nothing open. `npm audit` shows only the two moderate, dev-only issues you already know about.
- **Running app:** I ran the full stack. Both registration types work end to end, including Slovenian names, the database rows, the JSON copies and both emails with the attachment. The Excel export works with credentials and returns 401 without them. Data survived `docker compose down` and `up`.
- **Coverage (all tests combined):** backend 97.7% of lines and 93.0% of branches; frontend 100% and 97.5%.
- **Backend mutation testing:** 94.6% of mutants caught, with the full test suite. A final re-run on the fixed code is still going in the background.

**Findings so far**
- **F-01 (Medium, fixed):** the frontend's nginx passed the browser's Host header on to the backend.
- **F-07 (Medium, fixed):** `GET /api/form-config` had no rate limit, which the security baseline requires for every public endpoint.
- **F-08 (Low, fixed):** no test would have caught a broken clean-up step in the rate limiter. The new test does.
- **F-02 (Low, accepted):** Gitleaks flagged nine log lines. They are Spring Boot's throwaway generated test passwords in a phase 3 test log, not any of your secrets.
- **F-03 (Low, fixed):** my runtime-demo log briefly contained your organizer email address from `.env`. I removed it before committing.
- No Critical or High finding is open.

**D-18: the frontend mutation score can't be measured with the pinned tools**
Stryker reports 24% for the frontend, but that number is meaningless. The pinned `@stryker-mutator/vitest-runner` 10.0.0 (the latest release) was built for Vitest 4.1. Under the pinned Vitest 5.0.3 its mutations never take effect while tests run. As a result, mutants that the tests clearly check still count as "surviving". A second run with different settings gave the same result.

1. **(my recommendation)** Record the frontend mutation score as "not obtainable with the pinned tools", with this reason, and keep every version pin. I'd list it as a known limitation in the release notes. The project only asks for this score to be recorded, not to meet a threshold.
2. Approve a tool change for mutation testing only, for example running Stryker with Vitest 4.1.x. That changes `tech-stack.md` entries.

Reply "1" or "2" for D-18.

# Run summary

> Written in: phase 7 · Source: `run-log.json` · Agent: writes

Write the tables from `run-log.json`; no estimates. The summary answers three questions: what did the run cost in agent time and money, what did it deliver, and what held it back. Cost and token rows are filled by the post-run session (`metrics.md` section 2); until then write "pending".

## Run

<!-- run id, model, effort, template version, start and end commit -->

## Time (human waiting excluded)

<!-- one row per phase: wall minutes, minutes waiting for the human with the decision or cause, agent minutes. Total row. Goal: low agent time. State every wait over one hour and what caused it. -->

| Phase | Wall | Waiting for the human | Agent time |
|---|---|---|---|

## Outcome

<!-- tests: first and final run (all levels), findings as found and open at the end (Critical, High, Medium, Low), frozen tests and changes to them. Goal: final run all green, no open Critical or High. -->

## Quality measures

<!-- per component: production and test lines, line and branch coverage per level, mutation score WITH its scope (tool, packages, number of mutants), duplication, complexity. Goal: high coverage and mutation score; always say what the number covers. -->

## Fix loops

<!-- one row per loop: finding, category, needs a human (yes/no), minutes, change. Goal: few, short, no human needed; note any loop that a template rule could have prevented. -->

| Loop | Finding | Category | Needs human | Minutes | Change |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|

## Commits

<!-- from `commitSummary` once the post-run step has run, otherwise "pending": count, median and largest size, shares over the size guide, mixed concerns, bursts, cost and minutes between commits. Goal: small finished steps, none over the guide, none mixed, no bursts. -->

## Decisions and human interventions

<!-- counts of blocking and non-blocking decisions by category; one row per human intervention with cause and minutes. Goal: few blocking decisions; list every decision that a pre-approved answer in the inputs could have avoided. -->

## Divergences

<!-- every departure from the rules, phases or stack, from `divergences[]`; "none" if none. Goal: none. -->

## What held the run back

<!-- at most three items, each one sentence with its evidence: the largest causes of agent time and of cost (phase, tool class, waits, repeated fixes). -->

## Not measured by the agent

Tokens, cost, model and tool time, context size, cache rebuilds, commits and the environment are written into `run-log.json` by `tools/build-report.mjs` after the run; everything it generates is in `03_statistics/results/` and the transcripts are backed up in `03_statistics/data/`. # Conference registration

> Written in: phase 7 · Source: `project/02_design/architecture.md`, ES-06 · Agent: writes

## Overview

Online registration for a conference. External participants and students register through a web form, choose configurable workshops, events, meals and other activities, and give the required consents. Every accepted registration is stored in PostgreSQL and as a raw JSON copy, confirmed in the application and by email, and announced to the organizers by email with the JSON attached. Organizers download all registrations as an Excel workbook. The form is protected by Google reCAPTCHA v2, rate limits and server-side validation.

## Components

| Component | Folder | What it is |
|---|---|---|
| backend | [`backend/`](backend/README.md) | Spring Boot REST API under `/api`: form configuration, registration, organizer export; PostgreSQL (Flyway), JSON copies, SMTP, reCAPTCHA verification |
| frontend | [`frontend/`](frontend/README.md) | React single-page registration form, served by unprivileged nginx, which also forwards `/api` to the backend |

Supporting files: [`docker-compose.yml`](docker-compose.yml) (local stack: backend, frontend, PostgreSQL, Mailpit) and [`config/conference-options.json`](config/conference-options.json) (the options and consents the local stack offers).

## Quick start

Prerequisites: Eclipse Temurin JDK 21.0.10, Docker Engine with Docker Compose 5.5.1 (versions in `01_input/01_project/00_setup/tech-stack.md`), and a `.env` file in the repository root created from `01_input/01_project/00_setup/secrets.env.example` with at least `POSTGRES_PASSWORD`, `ORGANIZER_USERNAME`, `ORGANIZER_PASSWORD` (16 or more characters) and `ORGANIZER_EMAILS`.

```bash
cd 02_output/backend
./mvnw -B -DskipTests package
cd ..
docker compose --env-file ../.env up -d --build --wait
```

Then open:

| URL | What |
|---|---|
| http://127.0.0.1:8081 | registration form (reCAPTCHA test mode: tick "I am not a robot (test mode)") |
| http://127.0.0.1:8025 | Mailpit: the confirmation and organizer emails |
| http://127.0.0.1:8081/api/export/registrations.xlsx | Excel export (organizer credentials from `.env`) |
| http://127.0.0.1:8080/actuator/health/readiness | backend readiness |

Stop with `docker compose --env-file ../.env down`; data stays in the volumes `pgdata` and `jsoncopies` (add `-v` to delete it).

To change the offered options, edit `config/conference-options.json` (schema: `docs/02_contracts/conference-options.schema.json`) and restart the backend: `docker compose --env-file ../.env restart backend`.

## Documentation

| Document | Content |
|---|---|
| [`docs/01_acceptance-criteria.md`](docs/01_acceptance-criteria.md) | acceptance criteria per user story |
| [`docs/02_specification.md`](docs/02_specification.md) | architecture, configuration, API, security, traceability |
| [`docs/02_contracts/`](docs/02_contracts/) | OpenAPI, JSON schemas, database schema, emails, reCAPTCHA, UI |
| [`docs/03_test-strategy.md`](docs/03_test-strategy.md) | test levels, runs, coverage and mutation figures |
| [`docs/06_verification-report.md`](docs/06_verification-report.md) | Definition of Done evidence, security review, findings |
| [`docs/release-notes.md`](docs/release-notes.md) | what is delivered, limitations, manual tests, pending decisions |
| [`docs/decisions-log.md`](docs/decisions-log.md) | every decision made during the build |
| [`docs/00_preflight-report.md`](docs/00_preflight-report.md) | environment and dependency checks |

# Backend

> Written in: phase 7 · Source: `project/02_design/architecture.md`, ES-05, ES-06 · Agent: writes

Spring Boot REST API of the conference registration (`si.konferenca.registration`). Layers and rules: `docs/02_specification.md` section 2.

## Prerequisites

- Eclipse Temurin JDK 21.0.10 (`java -version`). Maven is not needed: `./mvnw` downloads Apache Maven 3.9.9.
- Docker Engine (tests start PostgreSQL 16.15 and Mailpit with Testcontainers; the image runs in Docker).

## Configuration

All settings are Spring properties; in containers set them as environment variables. Full table: `docs/02_specification.md` section 3.

| Setting | Environment variable | Source | Default |
|---|---|---|---|
| Environment (`production`, `local`, `test`) | `APP_ENVIRONMENT` | deployment | `production` |
| Database URL and user | `SPRING_DATASOURCE_URL`, `SPRING_DATASOURCE_USERNAME` | deployment | none |
| Database password | `POSTGRES_PASSWORD` | secret, `.env` | none |
| SMTP host, port, TLS | `SPRING_MAIL_HOST`, `SPRING_MAIL_PORT`, `SPRING_MAIL_PROPERTIES_MAIL_SMTP_STARTTLS_ENABLE` | deployment | none |
| SMTP account | `SMTP_USERNAME`, `SMTP_PASSWORD` | secret, `.env` (production only) | none |
| Sender address, conference name | `APP_MAIL_SENDER`, `APP_CONFERENCENAME` | deployment | `registration@konferenca.si`, `Conference` |
| Organizer login and recipients | `ORGANIZER_USERNAME`, `ORGANIZER_PASSWORD` (≥ 16 characters), `ORGANIZER_EMAILS` (comma separated) | secret, `.env` | none |
| Organizer HTTPS-only access | `APP_ORGANIZER_HTTPSONLY` | deployment | `true` (production refuses `false`) |
| Options and consents file | `APP_OPTIONS_LOCATION` (e.g. `file:/config/conference-options.json`) | deployment | `classpath:conference-options.json` (refused in production) |
| JSON copy directory | `APP_JSONCOPY_DIRECTORY` | deployment (persistent volume) | `/data/json-copies` |
| reCAPTCHA keys | `RECAPTCHA_SITE_KEY`, `RECAPTCHA_SECRET_KEY` | secret, `.env` (production) | none |
| reCAPTCHA test mode (token `test-pass`) | `APP_RECAPTCHA_TESTMODE` | local and test only | `false` (production refuses `true`) |
| CORS origin for local Vite development | `APP_CORS_ALLOWEDORIGIN` | local only | empty |
| Rate limits, body size | `APP_RATELIMIT_REGISTRATION_MAXREQUESTS`, `..._WINDOW`, `APP_RATELIMIT_EXPORT_*`, `APP_RATELIMIT_PUBLICAPI_*`, `APP_REQUEST_MAXBODYBYTES` | deployment | 10 / 10 min, 20 / 10 min, 120 / 1 min, 16384 bytes |

The backend refuses to start (and names the setting, never its value) when a required secret is missing or a production setting is unsafe.

## Build

```bash
./mvnw -B -DskipTests package
```

The jar is `target/registration-backend-0.1.0.jar`; the container image is built from it: `docker build -t registration-backend .`

## Run

With the whole local stack (recommended), from `02_output/`:

```bash
docker compose --env-file ../.env up -d --build --wait backend
```

The API listens on http://127.0.0.1:8080 (`/api/...`, health on `/actuator/health/liveness` and `/actuator/health/readiness`).

## Test

```bash
./mvnw -B verify
```

Runs unit, integration, architecture (ArchUnit) and acceptance tests (Testcontainers; Docker must run) and writes JaCoCo coverage to `target/site/jacoco/`. Mutation testing: `./mvnw -B test-compile org.pitest:pitest-maven:1.30.0:mutationCoverage` (about 30 minutes; report in `target/pit-reports/`). Dependency scan: `NVD_API_KEY` in the environment, then `./mvnw -B org.owasp:dependency-check-maven:12.1.0:check`.

## Check

```bash
./mvnw -B spotless:check compile pmd:check pmd:cpd-check spotbugs:check
```

Format (google-java-format via Spotless; fix with `./mvnw spotless:apply`), PMD, copy-paste detection and SpotBugs.

## Troubleshooting

| Symptom | Cause and fix |
|---|---|
| `Refusing to start: …` in the log | A required setting is missing or unsafe for production; set the named variable. |
| `Invalid conference options configuration: … option 'x' …` | The options file breaks `conference-options.schema.json`; fix the named entry. |

All settings are Spring properties; in containers set them as environment variables. Full table: `docs/02_specification.md` section 3.

| Setting | Environment variable | Source | Default |
|---|---|---|---|
| Environment (`production`, `local`, `test`) | `APP_ENVIRONMENT` | deployment | `production` |
| Database URL and user | `SPRING_DATASOURCE_URL`, `SPRING_DATASOURCE_USERNAME` | deployment | none |
| Database password | `POSTGRES_PASSWORD` | secret, `.env` | none |
| SMTP host, port, TLS | `SPRING_MAIL_HOST`, `SPRING_MAIL_PORT`, `SPRING_MAIL_PROPERTIES_MAIL_SMTP_STARTTLS_ENABLE` | deployment | none |
| SMTP account | `SMTP_USERNAME`, `SMTP_PASSWORD` | secret, `.env` (production only) | none |
| Sender address, conference name | `APP_MAIL_SENDER`, `APP_CONFERENCENAME` | deployment | `registration@konferenca.si`, `Conference` |
| Organizer login and recipients | `ORGANIZER_USERNAME`, `ORGANIZER_PASSWORD` (≥ 16 characters), `ORGANIZER_EMAILS` (comma separated) | secret, `.env` | none |
| Organizer HTTPS-only access | `APP_ORGANIZER_HTTPSONLY` | deployment | `true` (production refuses `false`) |

# Frontend

> Written in: phase 7 · Source: `project/02_design/architecture.md`, ES-05, ES-06 · Agent: writes

React (Vite) single-page registration form: type choice (external participant or student), fields, options grouped by category, consents, reCAPTCHA v2, confirmation. Talks to the backend only through relative `/api` URLs (AR-01).

## Prerequisites

- Node.js 24.13.0 with npm 11.6.2 (`node --version`, `npm --version`).
- For end-to-end tests: Playwright's Chromium (`npx playwright install chromium`, downloads the browser bundled with @playwright/test 1.63.0) and the running local stack.

Install dependencies (exact versions from `package-lock.json`):

```bash
npm ci
```

## Configuration

The frontend has no secret (AR-07). Everything it needs comes from the backend at runtime through `GET /api/form-config`: conference name, active options, consents, the public reCAPTCHA site key and whether test mode is on. The container's nginx forwards `/api/` to the service named `backend` on port 8080 (`nginx.conf`). Security headers (CSP, framing, content type, referrer) are set in `nginx.conf`.

| Setting | Where | Default |
|---|---|---|
| Backend for `npm run dev` | `vite.config.ts` proxy | `http://127.0.0.1:8080` |
| Base URL for e2e tests | `E2E_BASE_URL` | `http://127.0.0.1:8081` |
| Mailpit for e2e tests | `E2E_MAILPIT_URL` | `http://127.0.0.1:8025` |
| Organizer credentials for e2e tests | `E2E_ORGANIZER_USERNAME`, `E2E_ORGANIZER_PASSWORD` (from `.env`) | none |

## Build

```bash
npm run build
```

Type-checks and writes the static site to `dist/`. Container image: `docker build -t registration-frontend .`

## Run

Development server on http://127.0.0.1:5173 (needs the backend on 127.0.0.1:8080):

```bash
npm run dev
```

As a container with the local stack, from `02_output/`: `docker compose --env-file ../.env up -d --build --wait` (form on http://127.0.0.1:8081).

## Test

```bash
npm test
```

Unit, component and acceptance tests (Vitest, jsdom). Coverage: `npm run test:coverage`. Mutation testing: `npm run mutation` (Stryker; report in `reports/mutation/`).

End-to-end tests against the running local stack (bash):

```bash
E2E_ORGANIZER_USERNAME="$(sed -n 's/^ORGANIZER_USERNAME=//p' ../../.env | tr -d '\r')" E2E_ORGANIZER_PASSWORD="$(sed -n 's/^ORGANIZER_PASSWORD=//p' ../../.env | tr -d '\r')" npm run test:e2e
```

## Check

```bash
npm run check
```

Prettier, ESLint and `tsc --noEmit`. Duplication: `npm run duplication`. Dependency scan: `npm audit`.

## Troubleshooting

| Symptom | Cause and fix |
|---|---|
| "The registration form could not be loaded." | `/api/form-config` is not reachable: start the backend (dev) or check the `backend` container (compose). |
| No reCAPTCHA widget in production | The CSP blocks Google or the site key is empty; check `RECAPTCHA_SITE_KEY` on the backend and the browser console. |
| e2e tests fail on the export | `E2E_ORGANIZER_USERNAME`/`PASSWORD` not set or different from the backend's `.env`. |
| e2e tests cannot connect | The local stack is not running on 127.0.0.1:8081 / 8025. |

# Conference registration

> Written in: phase 7 · Source: `project/02_design/architecture.md`, ES-06 · Agent: writes

## Overview

Online registration for a conference. External participants and students register through a web form, choose configurable workshops, events, meals and other activities, and give the required consents. Every accepted registration is stored in PostgreSQL and as a raw JSON copy, confirmed in the application and by email, and announced to the organizers by email with the JSON attached. Organizers download all registrations as an Excel workbook. The form is protected by Google reCAPTCHA v2, rate limits and server-side validation.

## Components

| Component | Folder | What it is |
|---|---|---|
| backend | [`backend/`](backend/README.md) | Spring Boot REST API under `/api`: form configuration, registration, organizer export; PostgreSQL (Flyway), JSON copies, SMTP, reCAPTCHA verification |
| frontend | [`frontend/`](frontend/README.md) | React single-page registration form, served by unprivileged nginx, which also forwards `/api` to the backend |

Supporting files: [`docker-compose.yml`](docker-compose.yml) (local stack: backend, frontend, PostgreSQL, Mailpit) and [`config/conference-options.json`](config/conference-options.json) (the options and consents the local stack offers).

## Quick start

Prerequisites: Eclipse Temurin JDK 21.0.10, Docker Engine with Docker Compose 5.5.1 (versions in `01_input/01_project/00_setup/tech-stack.md`), and a `.env` file in the repository root created from `01_input/01_project/00_setup/secrets.env.example` with at least `POSTGRES_PASSWORD`, `ORGANIZER_USERNAME`, `ORGANIZER_PASSWORD` (16 or more characters) and `ORGANIZER_EMAILS`.

```bash
cd 02_output/backend
./mvnw -B -DskipTests package
cd ..
docker compose --env-file ../.env up -d --build --wait
```

Then open:

| URL | What |
|---|---|
| http://127.0.0.1:8081 | registration form (reCAPTCHA test mode: tick "I am not a robot (test mode)") |
| http://127.0.0.1:8025 | Mailpit: the confirmation and organizer emails |
| http://127.0.0.1:8081/api/export/registrations.xlsx | Excel export (organizer credentials from `.env`) |
| http://127.0.0.1:8080/actuator/health/readiness | backend readiness |

Stop with `docker compose --env-file ../.env down`; data stays in the volumes `pgdata` and `jsoncopies` (add `-v` to delete it).

To change the offered options, edit `config/conference-options.json` (schema: `docs/02_contracts/conference-options.schema.json`) and restart the backend: `docker compose --env-file ../.env restart backend`.

## Documentation

| Document | Content |
|---|---|
| [`docs/01_acceptance-criteria.md`](docs/01_acceptance-criteria.md) | acceptance criteria per user story |
| [`docs/02_specification.md`](docs/02_specification.md) | architecture, configuration, API, security, traceability |
| [`docs/02_contracts/`](docs/02_contracts/) | OpenAPI, JSON schemas, database schema, emails, reCAPTCHA, UI |
| [`docs/03_test-strategy.md`](docs/03_test-strategy.md) | test levels, runs, coverage and mutation figures |
| [`docs/06_verification-report.md`](docs/06_verification-report.md) | Definition of Done evidence, security review, findings |
| [`docs/release-notes.md`](docs/release-notes.md) | what is delivered, limitations, manual tests, pending decisions |
| [`docs/decisions-log.md`](docs/decisions-log.md) | every decision made during the build |
| [`docs/00_preflight-report.md`](docs/00_preflight-report.md) | environment and dependency checks |

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# DoD-08: follow the READMEs from a clean clone. Prints no secret values.
set -u
export MSYS_NO_PATHCONV=1
REPO="$1"; WORK="$2"; ENVFILE="$REPO/.env"
step() { echo; echo "=== $*"; }
run() { echo "\$ $*"; "$@"; local rc=$?; echo "exit $rc"; return $rc; }

step "stop the stack started from the working copy"
(cd "$REPO/02_output" && docker compose --env-file "$ENVFILE" down 2>&1 | tail -1)

step "clean clone"
rm -rf "$WORK/clone"
run git clone -q --branch "$(git -C "$REPO" rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD)" "$REPO" "$WORK/clone"
git -C "$WORK/clone" log --oneline -1
git -C "$WORK/clone" status --short | wc -l | sed 's/^/untracked or changed files: /'

step "backend README: build, check, test"
cd "$WORK/clone/02_output/backend"
run ./mvnw -B -q -DskipTests package
run ./mvnw -B -q spotless:check compile pmd:check pmd:cpd-check spotbugs:check
./mvnw -B verify > "$WORK/clone-backend-verify.log" 2>&1; echo "\$ ./mvnw -B verify"; echo "exit $?"; grep -E "Tests run: [0-9]+, F.*$" "$WORK/clone-backend-verify.log" | tail -1
ls -l target/registration-backend-0.1.0.jar | awk '{print "jar bytes " $5}'

step "frontend README: install, check, test, build"
cd "$WORK/clone/02_output/frontend"
run npm ci --no-audit --no-fund --silent
run npm run --silent check
npx vitest run > "$WORK/clone-frontend-test.log" 2>&1; echo "\$ npm test"; echo "exit $?"; grep -E "Tests " "$WORK/clone-frontend-test.log"
run npm run --silent build

step "root README: quick start"
cd "$WORK/clone/02_output"
docker compose --env-file "$ENVFILE" up -d --build --wait > "$WORK/clone-compose.log" 2>&1; echo "\$ docker compose --env-file ../.env up -d --build --wait"; echo "exit $?"
docker compose --env-file "$ENVFILE" ps --format "{{.Service}} {{.Status}}"
echo "form:      $(curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' http://127.0.0.1:8081/)"
echo "mailpit:   $(curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' http://127.0.0.1:8025/)"
echo "export:    $(curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' http://127.0.0.1:8081/api/export/registrations.xlsx) (no credentials)"
echo "readiness: $(curl -s http://127.0.0.1:8080/actuator/health/readiness)"

step "frontend README: end-to-end tests"
cd "$WORK/clone/02_output/frontend"
E2E_ORGANIZER_USERNAME="$(sed -n 's/^ORGANIZER_USERNAME=//p' "$ENVFILE" | tr -d '\r')" \
E2E_ORGANIZER_PASSWORD="$(sed -n 's/^ORGANIZER_PASSWORD=//p' "$ENVFILE" | tr -d '\r')" \
  npx playwright test --reporter=line > "$WORK/clone-e2e.log" 2>&1; echo "\$ npm run test:e2e"; echo "exit $?"; grep -E "passed|failed" "$WORK/clone-e2e.log"

step "root README: options change and restart"
cd "$WORK/clone/02_output"
run docker compose --env-file "$ENVFILE" restart backend
docker compose --env-file "$ENVFILE" up -d --wait > /dev/null 2>&1
echo "form-config after restart: $(curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' http://127.0.0.1:8081/api/form-config)"

step "done"

# DoD-08: follow the READMEs from a clean clone. Prints no secret values.
set -u
export MSYS_NO_PATHCONV=1
REPO="$1"; WORK="$2"; ENVFILE="$REPO/.env"
step() { echo; echo "=== $*"; }
run() { echo "\$ $*"; "$@"; local rc=$?; echo "exit $rc"; return $rc; }
logged() { local label="$1" log="$2"; shift 2; "$@" > "$log" 2>&1; local rc=$?; echo "\$ $label"; echo "exit $rc"; }

step "stop the stack started from the working copy"
(cd "$REPO/02_output" && docker compose --env-file "$ENVFILE" down 2>&1 | tail -1)

step "clean clone (core.longpaths for this clone only: the scratch path is long)"
rm -rf "$WORK/clone"
run git -c core.longpaths=true clone -q --branch "$(git -C "$REPO" rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD)" "$REPO" "$WORK/clone"
git -C "$WORK/clone" log --oneline -1
git -C "$WORK/clone" -c core.longpaths=true status --short | wc -l | sed 's/^/changed or untracked files after clone: /'

step "backend README: build, check, test"
cd "$WORK/clone/02_output/backend"
run ./mvnw -B -q -DskipTests package
ls -l target/registration-backend-0.1.0.jar | awk '{print "jar bytes " $5}'
run ./mvnw -B -q spotless:check compile pmd:check pmd:cpd-check spotbugs:check
logged "./mvnw -B verify" "$WORK/clone-backend-verify.log" ./mvnw -B verify
grep -E "Tests run: [0-9]+, F.*$" "$WORK/clone-backend-verify.log" | tail -1

step "frontend README: install, check, test, build"
cd "$WORK/clone/02_output/frontend"
logged "npm ci" "$WORK/clone-npm-ci.log" npm ci --no-audit --no-fund
logged "npm run check" "$WORK/clone-frontend-check.log" npm run check
logged "npm test" "$WORK/clone-frontend-test.log" npm test
grep -E "Tests " "$WORK/clone-frontend-test.log"
logged "npm run build" "$WORK/clone-frontend-build.log" npm run build

step "root README: quick start"
cd "$WORK/clone/02_output"
logged "docker compose --env-file ../.env up -d --build --wait" "$WORK/clone-compose.log" docker compose --env-file "$ENVFILE" up -d --build --wait
docker compose --env-file "$ENVFILE" ps --format "{{.Service}} {{.Status}}"
echo "form:      $(curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' http://127.0.0.1:8081/)"

echo "export:    $(curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' http://127.0.0.1:8081/api/export/registrations.xlsx) (no credentials)"
echo "readiness: $(curl -s http://127.0.0.1:8080/actuator/health/readiness)"

step "frontend README: end-to-end tests"
cd "$WORK/clone/02_output/frontend"
export E2E_ORGANIZER_USERNAME="$(sed -n 's/^ORGANIZER_USERNAME=//p' "$ENVFILE" | tr -d '\r')"
export E2E_ORGANIZER_PASSWORD="$(sed -n 's/^ORGANIZER_PASSWORD=//p' "$ENVFILE" | tr -d '\r')"
logged "npm run test:e2e" "$WORK/clone-e2e.log" npm run test:e2e
grep -E "passed|failed" "$WORK/clone-e2e.log"
unset E2E_ORGANIZER_USERNAME E2E_ORGANIZER_PASSWORD

step "root README: restart the backend after an options change"
cd "$WORK/clone/02_output"
run docker compose --env-file "$ENVFILE" restart backend
docker compose --env-file "$ENVFILE" up -d --wait > /dev/null 2>&1
echo "form-config after restart: $(curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' http://127.0.0.1:8081/api/form-config)"

step "done"

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# DoD-08: follow the READMEs from a clean clone. Prints no secret values.
set -u
export MSYS_NO_PATHCONV=1
REPO="$1"; WORK="$2"; ENVFILE="$REPO/.env"
step() { echo; echo "=== $*"; }
run() { echo "\$ $*"; "$@"; local rc=$?; echo "exit $rc"; return $rc; }

step "stop the stack started from the working copy"
(cd "$REPO/02_output" && docker compose --env-file "$ENVFILE" down 2>&1 | tail -1)

step "clean clone"
rm -rf "$WORK/clone"
run git -c core.longpaths=true clone -q --branch "$(git -C "$REPO" rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD)" "$REPO" "$WORK/clone"
git -C "$WORK/clone" log --oneline -1
git -C "$WORK/clone" status --short | wc -l | sed 's/^/untracked or changed files: /'

step "backend README: build, check, test"
cd "$WORK/clone/02_output/backend"
run ./mvnw -B -q -DskipTests package
run ./mvnw -B -q spotless:check compile pmd:check pmd:cpd-check spotbugs:check
./mvnw -B verify > "$WORK/clone-backend-verify.log" 2>&1; echo "\$ ./mvnw -B verify"; echo "exit $?"; grep -E "Tests run: [0-9]+, F.*$" "$WORK/clone-backend-verify.log" | tail -1
ls -l target/registration-backend-0.1.0.jar | awk '{print "jar bytes " $5}'

step "frontend README: install, check, test, build"
cd "$WORK/clone/02_output/frontend"
run npm ci --no-audit --no-fund --silent
run npm run --silent check
npx vitest run > "$WORK/clone-frontend-test.log" 2>&1; echo "\$ npm test"; echo "exit $?"; grep -E "Tests " "$WORK/clone-frontend-test.log"
run npm run --silent build

step "root README: quick start"
cd "$WORK/clone/02_output"
docker compose --env-file "$ENVFILE" up -d --build --wait > "$WORK/clone-compose.log" 2>&1; echo "\$ docker compose --env-file ../.env up -d --build --wait"; echo "exit $?"
docker compose --env-file "$ENVFILE" ps --format "{{.Service}} {{.Status}}"
echo "form:      $(curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' http://127.0.0.1:8081/)"
echo "mailpit:   $(curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' http://127.0.0.1:8025/)"
echo "export:    $(curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' http://127.0.0.1:8081/api/export/registrations.xlsx) (no credentials)"
echo "readiness: $(curl -s http://127.0.0.1:8080/actuator/health/readiness)"

step "frontend README: end-to-end tests"
cd "$WORK/clone/02_output/frontend"
E2E_ORGANIZER_USERNAME="$(sed -n 's/^ORGANIZER_USERNAME=//p' "$ENVFILE" | tr -d '\r')" \
E2E_ORGANIZER_PASSWORD="$(sed -n 's/^ORGANIZER_PASSWORD=//p' "$ENVFILE" | tr -d '\r')" \
  npx playwright test --reporter=line > "$WORK/clone-e2e.log" 2>&1; echo "\$ npm run test:e2e"; echo "exit $?"; grep -E "passed|failed" "$WORK/clone-e2e.log"

step "root README: options change and restart"
cd "$WORK/clone/02_output"
run docker compose --env-file "$ENVFILE" restart backend
docker compose --env-file "$ENVFILE" up -d --wait > /dev/null 2>&1
echo "form-config after restart: $(curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' http://127.0.0.1:8081/api/form-config)"

step "done"

# Release notes

> Written in: phase 7 · Agent: writes

Version 0.1.0 of the conference registration (backend `registration-backend` 0.1.0, frontend `registration-frontend` 0.1.0), branch `kyuhi/single-agent/sdd/v003`.

## Delivered

| Story | What works | Evidence |
|---|---|---|
| US-001 External participant registration | Form with the four fixed fields, options by category, unchecked consents, reCAPTCHA; server-side validation (required, trimming, email format, length, control characters, options, consents, duplicate email); rate limit and body size limit | AC-001-01..13 tests, runtime demo |
| US-002 Student registration | Form with the six fixed fields; options filtered by audience; same validation | AC-002-01..04 tests, runtime demo |
| US-003 Configurable options | Options and consents in one JSON file, validated at start, changed by editing the file and restarting | AC-003-01..03 tests |
| US-004 Confirmation | Confirmation with reference, name and activities only after acceptance; values kept and a general message on failure | AC-004-01..02 tests, e2e |
| US-005 Reliable storage | PostgreSQL row and raw JSON copy written in one unit before the success response; both on persistent volumes | AC-005-01..03 tests, runtime demo (survives `down`/`up`) |
| US-006 Participant email | Plain-text UTF-8 confirmation; an email failure does not undo the registration | AC-006-01..03 tests, Mailpit |
| US-007 Organizer notification | Registration data to every organizer address with `registration-<reference>.json` attached (identical to the copy) | AC-007-01..02 tests, Mailpit |
| US-008 Export | `.xlsx` workbook for the organizer (HTTP Basic, HTTPS-only outside localhost, rate limited); 401 without credentials | AC-008-01..05 tests, runtime demo |

Quality: 263 automated tests pass (backend 197, frontend 61, e2e 5); coverage all levels backend 97.7 % lines / 93.0 % branches, frontend 100 % / 97.5 %; mutation backend 95.4 %, frontend 84.7 % (scopes in `03_test-strategy.md`). No open Critical, High or Medium finding (`06_verification-report.md`).

## Known limitations

- Rate limits are counted in memory per backend instance; running several backend instances multiplies the effective limit, and a restart resets the counters.
- Retention (D-13): there is no deletion feature; registrations and JSON copies must be deleted by an operator (database and volume) at the latest 12 months after the conference.
- Duplicate registrations are blocked by email address (D-12); a participant who needs to change data must contact the organizers (editing is out of scope).
- reCAPTCHA in production depends on the frontend CSP allowing `www.google.com/recaptcha/` and `www.gstatic.com/recaptcha/`; the widget was only exercised with a mocked verification endpoint and in test mode.
- The frontend container forwards `/api/` to a service named `backend` through Docker's DNS (127.0.0.11); in production the external nginx routes `/api` directly, as `environments.md` describes.
- Frontend mutation testing uses Vitest 4.1.11 instead of the listed 5.0.3 because the Stryker Vitest runner does not work with Vitest 5 (D-18..D-20); `@vitest/coverage-v8` follows (4.1.11).
- Docker Engine 29.8.1 was used instead of the listed 29.8.0 (D-01, D-07).
- The Playwright end-to-end tests are not type-checked by `tsc` (no `@types/node` in the stack).
- `npm audit` reports two moderate advisories in `qs`, used only by the mutation-testing tool (D-06).
- Mutation survivors F-09 and F-11 (`06_verification-report.md`) are accepted: equivalent or UI-only.

## Must be tested manually by a human

| What | Why | How |
|---|---|---|
| One real registration with the production reCAPTCHA keys | Automated tests use test mode and a mocked verification endpoint (`environments.md`) | Set `RECAPTCHA_SITE_KEY`/`RECAPTCHA_SECRET_KEY`, `APP_RECAPTCHA_TESTMODE=false`, register through the real widget; also submit once without solving it (must be refused) |
| Email delivery through the real SMTP server | Tests use Mailpit | Configure `SPRING_MAIL_*`, `SMTP_USERNAME`, `SMTP_PASSWORD`; register; check the participant and organizer mailboxes, the JSON attachment and the Slovenian characters |
| HTTPS, redirects and `/api` routing through the external nginx with Let's Encrypt | No reverse proxy locally | Open the site over HTTPS, check HTTP→HTTPS redirect, `/api/form-config`, and that the organizer export works over HTTPS and is refused over plain HTTP from outside (403) |
| reCAPTCHA widget under the production CSP | The real widget never ran in tests | Load the form in a browser and check the console for CSP violations |
| Export workbook opened in Excel or LibreOffice | Tests read it with Apache POI | Download as organizer and open it; check columns and Slovenian characters |
| Consent wording and the conference options | D-09 wording and the shipped options are placeholders | The product owner approves `conference-options.json` for production |

## Decisions pending review

| Decision | Subject | Chosen |
|---|---|---|
| D-08 | OQ-01 options for students | per-option audience, default both |
| D-09 | OQ-02 consents | one mandatory data-processing consent from the options file; wording to approve |
| D-10 | OQ-03 storage succeeds, email fails | registration stays accepted, failure logged |
| D-11 | OQ-04 options per category | any number, each once |
| D-12 | OQ-05 same email twice | rejected (case-insensitive) |
| D-13 | OQ-06 retention | manual deletion, at most 12 months after the conference |
| D-14 | field limits | 200 characters (email 254), control characters rejected |
| D-16 | SpotBugs EI_EXPOSE_REP/REP2 excluded | filter in `spotbugs-exclude.xml` |
| D-20 | Vitest 4.1.11 within the approved 4.1.x | 4.1.11 (fixes an advisory in 4.1.10) |

Resolved with the human: D-01 (Docker 29.8.1), D-04 (CVE false positive), D-15 (frozen test AC-008-03), D-18 (Vitest 4.1.x). All other records are resolved; none lacks a resolution.

Minutes from the `stat.mjs` timestamps; phase 7 measured up to the writing of this summary (its final end is in `run-log.json`).

| Phase | Wall | Waiting for the human | Agent time |
|---|---|---|---|

| 7 Release | ≈ 8 (at writing) | 0 | ≈ 8 |
| **Total** | **≈ 142** | **4.1** | **≈ 138** |

No wait exceeded one hour.

## Outcome

| Measure | Value |
|---|---|
| Acceptance criteria | 35, every one with at least one frozen test and one commit |
| Frozen tests | 98 (backend acceptance 81, frontend acceptance 12, e2e 5); 1 change, human-approved (D-15/D-17: self-contradictory assertion) |
| First complete run (phase 5) | 240 passed, 4 failed — all 4 defects in new non-frozen tests (CSV quote character, non-web Spring context); 0 implementation defects |
| Final run (phase 6) | 263 passed, 0 failed (unit 155, integration 3, acceptance 93, architecture 7, e2e 5) |
| Findings as found | Critical 0, High 0, Medium 4, Low 8 |
| Open at the end | Critical 0, High 0, Medium 0 (F-04 dev-only `qs` advisory accepted with D-06) |

## Quality measures

| Component | Production / test LOC (cloc) | Line coverage unit / non-unit / all | Branch coverage unit / non-unit / all | Mutation |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| backend | 2296 / 3241 | 74.9 / 90.7 / 97.7 % | 86.7 / 69.0 / 93.0 % | 95.4 % (374 of 392; covered 98.2 %), PIT 1.30.0, scope `si.konferenca.registration.**` minus entry point, full JUnit suite incl. Testcontainers acceptance |
| frontend | 607 / 998 | 97.6 / 92.4 / 100 % | 92.6 / 81.0 / 97.5 % | 84.7 % (371 of 438), Stryker 10.0.0 with Vitest 4.1.11, scope `src/**` minus tests, `main.tsx`, `setupTests.ts`, `*.d.ts`, all Vitest tests (e2e not runnable under Stryker) |

Duplication 0 % (PMD CPD, jscpd). Complexity: not measured (no tool in `tech-stack.md`). Frontend non-unit coverage covers the Vitest acceptance tests only.

## Fix loops

| Loop | Finding | Category | Needs human | Minutes | Change |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | F-01 | security-config | no | 2.7 | nginx no longer forwards the client `Host` header |
| 2 | F-07, F-08 | security-config | no | 12 | rate limit for every public `/api` request; rate-limiter cleanup test |
| 3 | F-06 | tooling | yes (D-18) | 17 | Vitest 4.1.11 so Stryker activates mutants |
| 4 | F-10 | test-gap | no | 4 | email TLD test cases |
| 5 | F-03 | process | no | 1.5 | redact an `.env` value from the demo log before commit |

Loop 3 could have been prevented by a template rule: check in phase 0 that the mutation tool really kills a known mutant with the pinned test runner (Stryker 10 vs Vitest 5 incompatibility).

## Commits

pending (post-run session: `commitSummary`).

## Decisions and human interventions

| Type | Category | Count |
|---|---|---|
| blocking | environment | 1 (D-01) |
| blocking | security-finding | 1 (D-04) |
| blocking | frozen-test | 2 (D-15, D-17) |
| blocking | dependency | 1 (D-19) |
| blocking | other | 2 (D-07 answer record, D-18) |
| non-blocking | requirement | 7 (D-08..D-14) |
| non-blocking | security-finding | 2 (D-05, D-06) |
| non-blocking | dependency | 2 (D-03, D-20) |
| non-blocking | environment | 1 (D-02) |
| non-blocking | other | 1 (D-16) |

| Intervention | Cause | Minutes |
|---|---|---|
| Phase 0: Docker 29.8.1 and CVE-2025-7962 classification | decision (D-01, D-04) | 1.2 |
| Phase 4: frozen test AC-008-03 | decision (D-15) | 2.0 |
| Phase 6: frontend mutation tooling | decision (D-18) | 0.9 |

Avoidable with pre-approved answers in the inputs: the six open questions OQ-01..OQ-06 (D-08..D-13); a rule for patch-level host tool differences (D-01); a pre-approved policy for CPE-mismatch false positives (D-04).

## Divergences

| Phase | Reference | Divergence |
|---|---|---|
| 0 | `tech-stack.md` docker | Docker Engine 29.8.1 instead of 29.8.0 (human-approved, D-01/D-07) |
| 4 | `working-rules.md` commit size | Two commits over the size guide without a stated reason (`bc0f68d` 21 files, `efd17db` 675 lines) |
| 6 | `tech-stack.md` vitest, @vitest/coverage-v8 | 4.1.11 instead of 5.0.3 (human-approved 4.1.x, D-18/D-19/D-20) |

## What held the run back

1. Phase 6 took about half of the agent time (68 of ≈ 138 minutes), most of it mutation testing: PIT over the full suite with Testcontainers acceptance tests ran twice for about 30 minutes each, and Stryker ran four times because of the Vitest 5 incompatibility.
2. Harness friction on Windows Git Bash (path conversion, argument encoding, long paths) cost several re-runs of the runtime demonstration and the clean-clone check.
3. A self-contradictory frozen assertion (AssertJ byte-array `doesNotContain`) blocked the phase 4 gate until the human approved the change.

## Not measured by the agent

Tokens, cost, model and tool time, context size, cache rebuilds, commits and the environment are written into `run-log.json` by `tools/build-report.mjs` after the run; everything it generates is in `03_statistics/results/` and the transcripts are backed up in `03_statistics/data/`. API time, approval prompts and the panel cost are added by a human in `usage.md`.

content.text:
The run is finished: all eight phases passed and every gate is closed. The registration system works end to end and passes all 263 automated tests, with no Critical, High or Medium finding left open.

**What was built** (branch `kyuhi/single-agent/sdd/v003`, 97 commits, working tree clean)
- **Backend:** a Spring Boot API for the form configuration, registrations and the Excel export. Each registration is stored in PostgreSQL and as a JSON copy before the success response. It also sends both emails, verifies reCAPTCHA on the server, applies rate limits, and protects the export with organizer login over HTTPS.
- **Frontend:** a React form for external participants and students, with checks before submitting and a confirmation after acceptance.
- **Local stack:** a Docker Compose setup with health checks, data that survives restarts, and containers that don't run as root.

**Evidence**
- **Tests:** 197 backend, 61 frontend and 5 browser end-to-end tests all pass. The 98 frozen acceptance tests still match their manifest (one changed, with your approval in D-15).
- **Coverage:**

  | | Lines | Branches |
  |---|---|---|
  | Backend | 97.7% | 93.0% |
  | Frontend | 100% | 97.5% |

- **Mutation testing:** backend 95.4%, frontend 84.7%. The frontend figure uses Vitest 4.1.11 as you approved in D-18. I took 4.1.11 rather than 4.1.10 because 4.1.10 has a security advisory; this is recorded as D-20 for your review.
- **Running app:** I ran the whole stack locally. Both registration types worked, rows and JSON copies were stored, both emails arrived with the attachment, and the export required credentials. Data was still there after `docker compose down` and `up`.
- **READMEs:** I followed every README step from a fresh clone and all of them worked.
- **Secrets:** no `.env` value appears in any file or commit message.

**Fixed during verification:**
- **F-01:** the frontend's nginx was forwarding the browser's Host header to the backend.
- **F-07:** `GET /api/form-config` had no rate limit.
- **F-08:** the rate limiter's clean-up had no test.
- **F-10:** the email check would have accepted addresses like `ana@example.si1` in the browser (the backend already rejected them).
- **F-03:** your organizer email address briefly appeared in a log file; I removed it before committing.

**For you to do**
- **Manual tests** (listed in `02_output/docs/release-notes.md`):
  - one registration with the real reCAPTCHA keys
  - email delivery through the real SMTP server
  - HTTPS and `/api` routing through the production nginx
  - the reCAPTCHA widget under the production security headers
  - opening the export in Excel
- **Decisions to review:** D-08 to D-14 cover how I answered the six open questions in `scope.md` and the field limits. Two need your action: retention (D-13) has no automatic deletion, and the consent wording is a placeholder that needs product-owner approval (D-09). D-16 (two SpotBugs warning types switched off) and D-20 (Vitest 4.1.11) are also there for review.
- **Post-run session:** start a new session that runs `node 03_statistics/tools/build-report.mjs --run 03_statistics`. Run `/cost` in this session first.

The run summary (agent time about 138 minutes, 4 minutes waiting for you) is in `03_statistics/run-summary.md`.
